verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents deploying into your own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation. That lets a customer control where processing and data reside, but the evidence never mentions selectable regions or data-residency guarantees, so residency choice is only implied. missing for 10: explicit region selection or data-residency documentation, region options for the standard SaaS tier, independent corroboration of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Deploy Unstructured in your own dedicated instance or VPC with multi-user access, full data isolation, dedicated technical support, and pricing tailored to your needs.
Learn how Unstructured dedicated instances protect data through encryption, private connectivity, and network access controls, with and without PrivateLink.
